name: intent_greeting
description: The user is greeting the robot or saying hello. Examples: 'hi', 'hello', 'hey there', 'good morning'.

name: intent_status
description: The user asks how the robot itself is doing or feeling. Examples: 'how are you', 'you ok', 'how's it going'.

name: intent_joke
description: The user wants to be entertained with a joke or something funny. Examples: 'tell me a joke', 'make me laugh', 'say something funny'.

name: intent_math
description: The user wants to compute a NUMERIC arithmetic calculation with numbers and operators only. Examples: '2 plus 2', '10 times 5', '100 divided by 4', 'what is 7 minus 3'. Do NOT use this for questions about places, facts, or words.

name: intent_time
description: The user asks for the current clock time. Examples: 'what time is it', 'tell me the time'.

name: intent_date
description: The user asks for today's calendar date or day of the week. Examples: 'what is the date', 'what day is it today'.

name: intent_robot_info
description: The user asks about the robot itself: its name, version, age, what it can do, or 'are you ...' questions. Examples: 'what is your name', 'are you smart', 'how old are you', 'what can you do'.

name: intent_fact
description: The user asks a general-knowledge or trivia question about the world: geography, capital cities, countries, planets, science, nature. Examples: 'what is the capital of France', 'what is the largest planet', 'how many continents are there'.

name: intent_open_app
description: The user asks to open, launch, or start an application on the device. Examples: 'open the camera', 'launch the browser', 'start maps'.

name: intent_device
description: The user asks the robot to control a device function: flashlight/torch on or off, volume up or down, check battery, or vibrate. Examples: 'flashlight on', 'volume up', 'what is my battery'.

name: intent_remember
description: The user tells the robot to remember a personal fact, or asks it to recall one. Examples: 'my name is Sam', 'remember I like tea', 'what is my name'.

name: intent_timer
description: The user asks to set a timer or a reminder for a duration. Examples: 'set a timer for 5 minutes', 'remind me in 30 seconds', 'timer for 2 min'.
